FOREWORD

By Dr, ARTHUR HUGHES, M.B.. P.R.O.S., 

Senior Medical Officer, Welsh Mission Hospital, 
Shillong. 

Dated, Shillong, the 16th Fehmanj 1944. 

This little book covers an enormous 
ground, ranging from anatomy through physiology 
and nutrition to the causes of infectious diseases 
and their treatment. It includes the basic princi- 
ples governing the planning of compounas and 
houses, and outlines the problems of rural 
hygiene. 

Without going into scientific details, which 
would only prove confusing in an elementary 
book of this character, it relates in an interesting 
manner the principal facts and their application in 
practice. 

As a School Reader a selection of chapters 
could be made for a yearns study or for classes of 
boys or of girls, and with this basis a teacher 
possessing any ability ought to be able to 
build up object lessons and draw topical examples 
for all the subjects set forth. 

1 sincerely hope that the maximum use may be 
made of the book, and that teachers will present 
it in such a way as to create an unending interest 
for the subject in the minds of the pupils. 

For Rural Communities there is no knowledge

more necessary or more facinating than that out- 
lined in this book, and one hopes that it will be 
used to broaden mental horizons and inculcate the 
laws of abundant health.
